model.initialization: fresh complete cached ImageNet encoder, including conv_head and norm_head; new ordered distribution head
model.head: Linear1280to256
model.nodes: fixed float32 linspace(0,1,256), saved buffer; no circular adjacency
model.distribution: float32 log_softmax of the single head output
model.readout: float32 sum(exp(logp)*all256nodes)/sum(exp(logp)); no clipping or peak selection
model.encoder_and_head_precision: AMP float16; log probability, CDF log-score and expectation float32 with autocast disabled

source.roll_validation_split: independent layout/seed/ID/group; same available HDR background

training.target_cdf: G_j=clamp(j+1-255*y,0,1), j=0..254; source scalar loss side only
training.loss_formula: -mean_B,j(G_j*logF_j+(1-G_j)*logS_j); left and right logcumsumexp of logp

config.checkpoint_selection: earliest strict minimum R=(original1506 mean NMAE + roll512 mean NMAE + original1506 worst10percent NMAE + roll512 worst10percent NMAE)/4; each worst tail uses ceil(.1*N), including failed inputs/scalars at error1
config.external_checkpoint: source-selected best only after source stopping rule completes
config.inference_input: ROI RGB, linear resize256, ImageNet normalization; one RGB forward, no GT geometry or target scalar input

initialization: fresh complete cached ImageNet1280 semantic encoder and one new256-node ordered distribution head
model_inputs: ROI RGB, linear resize256, ImageNet normalization; one RGB forward, no GT geometry or target scalar input
checkpoint_selection: earliest strict minimum R=(original1506 mean NMAE + roll512 mean NMAE + original1506 worst10percent NMAE + roll512 worst10percent NMAE)/4; each worst tail uses ceil(.1*N), including failed inputs/scalars at error1
source_stopping: complete epoch; >=60 and20 epochs without strict source score improvement, maximum160
external_scope: viewed Industrial1395/52 and RF100151/35; source-selected best once each after complete source training
